answer: Persistent Thread Endorsement. Each new agent identity must be endorsed along a live interaction thread by two agents with nonzero history, and that endorsement is stored in a shared vault as a signed record. Cloning forces the attacker to first build genuine history on each clone, since fresh identities cannot endorse. Each clone therefore costs real past transactions plus two endorsers willing to risk their own standing, making a comet of fake identities expensive to assemble.
